05b_1_clifford_products.png: Left: the number of Clifford products of each degree $k$ (the number of different gammas multiplied), which is the binomial number $\binom{8}{k}$: 1, 8, 28, 56, 70, 56, 28, 8, 1, in total 256; blue even degrees, orange odd degrees. Right: the exact rank of all products of degrees 0 to $k$ (dots) against the number of products added (horizontal axis); the dots lie on the dotted line rank = number of products, ending at 256: the 256 products are independent and span all 16 by 16 matrices.
